title: Raku Kiln - Full-Day Workshop
source_quote: Raku Kiln Workshop - Full Day - (4 -7 loads) - $450.00
evidence_sentence: A full-day Raku Kiln Workshop costs $450 and includes instruction on firing 4–7 loads of cone 06 raku ware; available on-site or off-site with additional fees.
evidence_quote: Raku Kiln Workshop - Full Day - (4 -7 loads) - $450.00... can offer a workshop at SAW (or offsite for an additional fee).
summary: Full-day raku firing workshop with instruction: fire 4–7 loads of raku ware, cone 06. $450 at SAW; additional fee for off-site workshops. SAW provides fuel, tongs, gloves, and sawdust for post-fire reduction.
cost_text: $450 full-day workshop; offsite workshops at additional fee. Raku glazes available at 10¢ per cubic inch if using SAW glazes.
how_to_join: Contact info@salemartworks.org to arrange on-site or off-site workshop
